stem.text: In some areas lime, $\text{Ca(OH)}_2$, is added to soil to improve crop growth.
Which statement correctly describes a reason why lime improves crop growth?

A.text: Lime acts as a catalyst which speeds up the release of nitrates into the soil.

B.text: Lime is an effective pesticide and protects the plants from damage.

C.text: Lime is used to reduce the acidity of the soil.

D.text: Lime lowers the pH of the soil.
